findings.text: _production_refused_cells short-circuits to [] whenever base.refused_cells() is zero, so the raised-capacity differencing arm its own docstring describes never runs for any of these eleven rows. The refusal predicate itself is sound and the review forced it to fire (capacity 100 yields 117 refused cells at MAST within the same instrument), but the census would be stronger with a committed forced-bound positive-control row so the absence is demonstrated in-node rather than only by a reviewer.

The headline smallest_saddle_wedge_margin of 5 is capacity minus the largest spline saddle wedge (136-131). The binding headroom against the one_arc_capacity the census tests is the support margin, 136-132 = 4. Both are consistent and neither refuses a cell, but the receipt could report the support margin beside the wedge margin so a reader does not read 5 as the support headroom.

The verdict covers single-null and limited production layouts only; no double-null diverted row exists in the evaluated banks, as the sibling analytic census already records for its own bank. A double-null row added to a bank later would be unmeasured by this census and would need its own two-run check.

follow_ons: Add a committed forced-bound control row to the production census so the production refusal predicate is shown to fire inside the node, not only under a reviewer's patch.

Report the support margin (capacity minus realised live maximum = 4) beside the saddle-wedge margin in the aggregate receipt, since the support count is the quantity the one-arc bound actually bounds.

justifications.durability: The receipts, the aggregate and the census script are committed and reproducible, and the census writes per-row partials so a lost process loses one row rather than the run. Two residual fragilities: the DIII-D rows require the governed machine cache to be passed explicitly because the script default remains the node-local tmpfs path, and the row logs span two revisions (MAST at 80d20b80c, DIII-D at 06a15267b) that a later reader reconciles against the docs-only HEAD commit carrying them.
justifications.evidence: Per-row provenance headers carry revision, tree, module, cwd and the literal command, and every accepted row ends EXIT=0. The eleven rows have eleven distinct identities with distinct axes and X-points and saddle-cell counts 0-2, so the uniform maximum of 132 is a layout fact rather than a replayed row. The independent probe reproduced two of the eleven rows exactly and, by forcing the one-arc capacity to 100, made the same production refusal predicate name 117 refused cells, so the reported zero is a measured absence. The node ships no in-node positive control, and its _production_refused_cells raised-bound differencing branch is dead behind an early return for every row, so the second instrument is untested.
justifications.fit: The census extends the established per-cell-count census seam to production banks and reports nullable refusal indices per row, so a later reader sees a positive finding as data rather than as an opaque verdict string.
justifications.goal_fidelity: §5 asks for a measurement of production diverted rows against the one-arc bound before declaring two runs. The node delivers the measurement on both production banks and returns the decision input with the correct one-run default bound.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff is confined to the granted census directory and the granted landing fragment; the worktree is clean and no plan or index file changed.

raw_text: VERDICT pass (91/100; goal_fidelity 19, evidence 17, scope_discipline 20, durability 16, fit 19). The production one-arc census answers the §5 question: eleven production diverted rows (six MAST slices, five DIII-D frames) each refuse zero cells at capacity 136 with a realised maximum of 132 live vertices, so the held two-run wiring 61b291089 does not land. The independent review reproduced the MAST 21978/35 and DIII-D frame 179 rows exactly and forced the one-arc capacity to 100, which made the same refusal predicate name 117 cells, confirming the reported zero is measured rather than vacuous. Findings are non-blocking: the differencing arm of _production_refused_cells is dead behind an early return, the headline margin is the wedge margin (5) rather than the support margin (4), and the banks carry no double-null diverted row. Accept.
